source: WorldPop Global2 R2025A, constrained, UN adjusted, 1 km
citation: Bondarenko M. et al. (2025). Global2: spatial distribution of population and age/sex structures 2015-2030, R2025A. WorldPop, University of Southampton.
method: Sum of 1 km cells whose centre lies in the place; places with fewer than 50 centres weight each touched cell by the share of it they cover. Under five = ages 0 and 1-4; women 15-49 = female ages 15 to 49.
